slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: 作为一个强盗，穆迪也有着自己的原则。
老头不抢，因为没几个钱
青壮不抢，因为打不过
商队不抢，因为商队有保镖
军队不抢，还要躲得远远地
冒险者不抢，因为冒险者装备好
小孩看情况抢，没钱也可以转卖给人口贩子
女人一定抢，没钱也没关系，玩腻了还可以卖到坤院去
至于前面这个外地人
穆迪舔了舔干裂的嘴唇，抬手招呼身旁的强盗同伴们一起包抄过去
那是一定要抢的。
虽然不知道这个黑头发的外地人什么时候出现在这里的，但碰上了就是缘分，看这家伙穿着一身破烂布衫，也不像是有地位的家伙，多半是跑到这里来投靠亲戚的农民，这种没有靠山的家伙就是穆迪这行里的大肥羊，不抢白不抢啊。
穆迪嗤笑一声，提着斧头便跳了出来。
“小子，我给你两个选项，要钱还是要命”
挥舞着斧头，穆迪抛出了自己的职业话术，寻常的农夫看见这架势当场腿就软了，少数反应快的会朝反方向逃跑，这时候就轮到穆迪的同伙堵路了。
看这外地人面无表情，不知道是被吓傻了还是在想什么鬼点子，穆迪略感不爽，准备招呼同伙上去好好教育一下这个外地人。
唉？同伙呢？
见挥手没反应，穆迪低头看向伙伴藏身的灌木丛，只见那原本青绿的灌木已经被染红，红色的液体从树叶上滴落，在地面汇成一滩滩小血洼。
穆迪吓的大叫，当即丢下斧头转身逃去。
可一阵诡异的吸力从背后传来，将穆迪吸了过去，随着后脑勺被一只大手盖住，穆迪瞬间失去了意识。
“强盗吗，有趣，看来这不是一般的秘境”
陈昭喃喃自语到，旋即丢下了强盗的尸身，检查了一番储物袋，见两口棺材还好好的停留在袋中，陈昭松了一口气。
自陈昭在洞穴的死路被天门宗的筑基长老一记术法击中，已经过去了数十息的时间，陈昭也逐渐适应了突变的环境。
看起来，自己好像被传送到了某个秘境之中。
摸了摸胸口衣服的裂口，陈昭还有些后怕。
那个环境下，要是真接了那记【天光斩】，恐怕陈昭会当场毙命吧。
不就刨了宗门的墓地吗，至于这么大仇吗？
好在，自己是活了下来，还来到了这个不知名秘境之中，恐怕，是得益于这枚玉石吧
陈昭看向手中的红色玉石，在陈昭来到这个秘境之后，手中便突然多出了这枚红色的玉石，用神识去感知这块玉石，并未有任何反应。
但将其遗弃在原地，一旦离开陈昭十几步，便会突然消失，重新出现在手中，即便是放在储物袋中也是一样，一旦距离拉开，便会回到手中。
content_en:
As a robber, Moody also has his own principles.
The old man didn’t rob because he didn’t have much money.
Young people don't fight because they can't beat them
The caravan will not rob because the caravan has bodyguards
The army will not rob, but will hide far away
The adventurers don’t grab it because the adventurers are well equipped.
Children can be robbed depending on the situation, and they can be resold to human traffickers if they have no money.
Women will definitely be robbed. It doesn’t matter if you don’t have money. When you get tired of playing with them, you can sell them to Kunyuan.
As for the foreigner in front of me
Moody licked his chapped lips and raised his hand to summon his fellow robbers to surround him.
That must be grabbed.
Although I don't know when this black-haired outsider appeared here, it was fate that I met him. Seeing that this guy was wearing a tattered shirt, he didn't look like a guy with status. He was probably a farmer who came here to seek refuge with his relatives. This kind of guy without a backer is the big fat sheep in Moody's industry.
Moody sneered and jumped out with an ax in hand.
"Boy, I'll give you two options, money or life."
Wielding his axe, Moody spoke his professional words. When ordinary farmers saw this posture, their legs would weaken on the spot. A few who reacted quickly would run away in the opposite direction. At this time, it was the turn of Moody's accomplices to block the road.
Seeing the expressionless expression on the outsider's face, he didn't know whether he was frightened or was thinking of some evil idea. Moody felt a little unhappy and was about to call his accomplices to go up and educate the outsider.
well? Where are the accomplices?
Seeing no response to his wave, Moody looked down at the bush where his friend was hiding, and saw that the originally green bush had been dyed red, and red liquid dripped from the leaves, forming small puddles of blood on the ground.
"Ah!"
Moody screamed in fright, immediately dropped his ax and ran away.
But a strange suction force came from behind, sucking Moody in. As the back of his head was covered by a big hand, Moody instantly lost consciousness.
------
------
------
"A robber? It's interesting. It seems like this is not an ordinary secret realm."
Chen Zhao murmured to himself, and immediately dropped the robber's body, checked the storage bag, and saw that the two coffins were still in the bag. Chen Zhao breathed a sigh of relief.
Dozens of breaths have passed since Chen Zhao was hit by a spell from the Tianmen Sect's Foundation Establishment Elder at the dead end of the cave, and Chen Zhao has gradually adapted to the sudden change in the environment.
It seemed as if he had been transported to some secret realm.
Touching the rip in the clothes on his chest, Chen Zhao was still a little scared.
Under that environment, if he really took that [Sky Light Slash], I'm afraid Chen Zhao would be killed on the spot.
Didn't they just dig up the sect's graveyard? How about such a big hatred?
Fortunately, I survived and came to this unknown secret realm, probably because of this jade stone.
Chen Zhao looked at the red jade in his hand. After Chen Zhao came to this secret realm, the red jade suddenly appeared in his hand. He used his spiritual consciousness to perceive the jade, but there was no reaction.
But if you leave it where it is, once it leaves Chen Zhao for more than ten steps, it will suddenly disappear and reappear in your hand, even if it is placed in a storage bag. Once the distance is further away, it will return to your hand.
